content:
The GPT-4o Era Is Ending

OpenAI has decided to simplify model diversity on the ChatGPT platform. In the statement made by the company, it was noted that some older versions, including GPT-4o, will be removed from the platform as of February 13.

The main reason behind the decision was cited as changing user habits. According to the data, a large majority of ChatGPT users carry out their operations through the GPT-5.2 model, which has a newer architecture. Low usage rates and the need for resource optimization accelerated the process of retiring GPT-4o.

  • Model to Be Removed: GPT-4o and related subversions.
  • Shutdown Date: February 13.
  • Focus Model: GPT-5.2.

This change aims to enable OpenAI to use its computing power more efficiently and concentrate its development processes on the most up-to-date models.
